To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the management variables ‘training and education’, ‘communication and information’, ‘top management support’, ‘user involvement’, ‘change management’ and ‘organizational readiness’ have significant influences on psychological acceptance factors (‘intention to use’, ‘attitude towards use’ and ‘perceived ease of use’) and that these factors in turn significantly influence actual user behaviour.

the proposed model explains the acceptance behaviour of users of a BI standard software package in a German company, with a focus on management activities, and that the proposed management activities have a significant influence on user acceptance.
the proposed management model explains a considerable amount of variance in user behaviour, which is the main goal of any implementation project.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a model to assess management activities during standard software implementations.
the management of user acceptance in the context of BI standard software implementations.
the management of user acceptance in standard software implementation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the management activities investigated here are of significant importance for the success of standard software implementations.
the proposed model is a valid and useful tool for the evaluation of management activities during company-wide standard software implementation projects.
the model is a useful tool for managers to evaluate their implementation activities.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a successful implementation of BI standard software is dependent on the acceptance of the users and the acceptance of the BI standard software is influenced by management activities.
the proposed model can serve as a valuable tool for BI software implementation managers and that the results of the study can help to improve the quality of BI implementations.
the management variables included in the proposed model have a significant influence on the psychological acceptance of BI standard software.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the implementation process is not just about technology. It requires the involvement of the entire organisation, including top-level management
the management activities investigated in the model can be used to systematically influence the success of BI implementations.
a systematic evaluation of management efforts can be used to improve the success of company-wide standard BI software implementations.
